# arianet_firewall (Resource)

A firewall: its rules and what it is applied to (servers and label selectors). Maps to `/cloud/v1/firewalls` (`PUT` for name and rules, `apply_to_resources`/`remove_from_resources` actions for targets).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "arianet_firewall" "web" {
  name = "web"

  rule {
    direction   = "in"
    protocol    = "tcp"
    port        = "22"
    source_ips  = ["203.0.113.0/24"]
    description = "SSH from the office"
  }

  rule {
    direction  = "in"
    protocol   = "tcp"
    port       = "443"
    source_ips = ["0.0.0.0/0", "::/0"]
  }

  apply_to = [
    { label_selector = "role=web" },
    { server = arianet_server.web.id },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Firewall name: letters, digits, dots and dashes, up to 63 characters.

### Optional

- `apply_to` (Attributes Set) What the firewall is applied to: each element sets exactly one of `server` (a server ID) or `label_selector` (e.g. `env=prod`). When omitted, targets are left as they are (e.g. managed by `arianet_firewall_attachment` or a server's `firewall_ids`); set `apply_to = []` to remove every target. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apply_to))
- `labels` (Map of String) User-defined labels (key/value pairs). Lists can be filtered by them with a label selector.
- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project the resource is in. Defaults to the account's default project; changing it moves the resource.
- `protection_delete` (Boolean) Whether the resource is protected from deletion. Must be set to false before the resource can be destroyed.
- `rule` (Block List) A rule. Rules are replaced as a whole on change. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--rule))
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Firewall ID.
- `server_ids` (Set of Number) Every server the firewall is on, directly or through a label selector.

<a id="nestedatt--apply_to"></a>
### Nested Schema for `apply_to`

Optional:

- `label_selector` (String) Label selector matching servers.
- `server` (Number) Server ID.


<a id="nestedblock--rule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule`

Required:

- `direction` (String) `in` or `out`.
- `protocol` (String) `tcp`, `udp`, `icmp`, `esp` or `gre`.

Optional:

- `description` (String) Description of the rule.
- `destination_ips` (List of String) Destination CIDRs (direction `out`).
- `port` (String) Port or range (`80`, `1024-65535`, `any`) for tcp and udp.
- `source_ips` (List of String) Source CIDRs (direction `in`).


<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import arianet_firewall.web 7
```
